_comment_cerebro_access_undeclared: CEREBRO-PATCH(reply-target-mention-suppression): TECH-3194 — reply-targets.ts and trigger-target-bar.tsx import @multica/cerebro-access/views as an undeclared workspace import ON PURPOSE. Declaring it here makes turbo see a build/typecheck cycle (cerebro-access already imports @multica/views), so it must stay out of dependencies; pnpm hoist resolves the import.
